response.sql: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT s.entrystat, sp.zoneref, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(sp.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY s.entrystat, sp.zoneref) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_ram_usage, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM site_stats GROUP BY entrystat;
